verdict.rationale: Luma documents an agent-readable API for submitting generations: llms.txt, a markdown mirror of every docs page, per-endpoint OpenAPI 3.1.0 definitions (including createGeneration), SDKs, and a per-model credit price table an agent could use to estimate cost. The evidence does not show a documented job-status or polling mechanism, a way to download the finished asset, or per-job cost reporting in API responses. The OpenAPI reference is also on the legacy docs generation, and no standalone spec file exists. missing for 10: documented job-status/polling (watch the job), documented asset retrieval, per-job cost returned by the API, current-generation machine-readable spec, hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end loop

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can run the full video loop from docs alone: submit the prompt, watch the job, fetch the asset, and report the cost

citations.quote: Two endpoints, Python/JS/TS SDKs, credit-based pricing, production-grade from day one
publishes per-endpoint OpenAPI 3.1.0 definitions in the markdown mirror of every reference page
Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.
